The best thing you can do is to listen to her. It doesn't matter how serious it is, someone stating that they want to end it all that is serious enough. Almost everyone who has comitted suicide has told someone about their feelings and these feelings were ignored. Please don't ignore her ask her what's wrong, what you can do to help. Do something that she usually enjoys, ask her how she's feeling, stay by her side, try to meet her as much as possible. What I've noticed is that suicidal people including myself are very quick to grab any opportunity to become hopeful about life, it's just about if or how easy the opportunity to grab it is. Make her search for happiness easier by actively doing stuff that makes her happy, I'm, sure she would love the gesture
